name: NucleusXR: Anatomy
summary:
Discover human anatomy from a new perspective with NucleusXR: Anatomy, an immersive learning experience for Meta Quest.

Explore detailed 3D models and understand how anatomical structures relate to one another. Whether you are beginning your studies or refreshing your knowledge, learn at your own pace.

**EXPLORE**
- Examine the human body and focus on individual structures.
- Show or hide anatomical systems to reveal their relationships.
- Use X-Ray views to examine structures that are otherwise concealed
